query:
SELECT w.status::text AS "status!",
                   (SELECT a.value -> 'settings' -> 'wait_for_signal'
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.activities) AS a
                    WHERE a.value ->> 'key' = $2
                    LIMIT 1) AS wait
            FROM workflows w
            JOIN workflow_definitions d ON d.id = w.workflow_definition_id
            WHERE w.id = $1
